edges.description: Patient cortical neurons show dysfunctional protein refolding and raised basal oxidative stress, supporting the proteostasis node, but not the heat-shock defect seen in the same patients' fibroblasts.
edges.limitations: The heat-shock readout does not discriminate in this model: patient neurons were resistant to heat stress with high basal HSP70, and an isogenic STUB1 knockout line behaved like the patient lines. The authors conclude the heat-shock arm may not be the neuropathological mechanism, so only the refolding and oxidative-stress readouts carry the link.

edges.description: Reproduces Purkinje cell loss and dendritic disorganization downstream of U-box loss of function, in an animal whose stub1 expression is concentrated in the same cerebellar layers as in humans.
edges.limitations: The mutant showed no gross cerebellar atrophy, unlike SCAR16 patients, so the model captures the cellular lesion without reproducing the tissue-level endpoint. It is also a truncation engineered in the fish orthologue rather than a patient allele, and models only the U-box arm of the mechanism, not the tetratricopeptide-repeat chaperone-binding arm.

edges.description: Homozygous animals show motor cerebellar dysfunction together with cognitive and learning deficits, matching the ataxia-plus-cognition profile of patients.
edges.limitations: The paper reports cerebellar motor dysfunction and learning deficits as behavioural phenotypes; it does not establish that the progressive cerebellar atrophy or the hypogonadism of human SCAR16 is reproduced, and the phenotype is explicitly distinct from the CHIP-null animal, so conclusions do not transfer between the two models.

nodes.description: Homozygous or compound heterozygous pathogenic variants in STUB1 are the initiating lesion. Variants are distributed across all three CHIP domains (tetratricopeptide-repeat, coiled-coil and U-box) and include missense, nonsense and frameshift alleles; a nonsense allele truncates the protein before the U-box and abolishes ligase activity outright.

evidence.reference_title: Identification of CHIP as a novel causative gene for autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia.
evidence.snippet: using a combination of whole-exome sequencing and linkage analysis, we identified CHIP, encoding a U-box containing ubiquitin E3 ligase, as a novel causative gene for autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia.

evidence.reference_title: In vitro characterization of six STUB1 variants in spinocerebellar ataxia 16 reveals altered structural properties for the encoded CHIP proteins.
evidence.snippet: Spinocerebellar ataxia, autosomal recessive 16 (SCAR16) is caused by biallelic mutations in the STIP1 homology and U-box containing protein 1 (STUB1) gene encoding the ubiquitin E3 ligase and dimeric co-chaperone C-terminus of Hsc70-interacting protein (CHIP).

nodes.description: Most SCAR16 variants lower the thermodynamic stability of CHIP. The destabilized protein forms soluble oligomers, is turned over faster by the proteasome, and is present at reduced steady-state levels in patient cells, so the functional deficit reflects loss of protein as well as loss of catalysis. Frank aggregation is not a general property of the allele set: of six variants characterized biophysically only p.Thr246Met showed a strong aggregation tendency, alongside structural disorganization of its U-box, while the others showed structural defects without it.

evidence.snippet: This destabilization caused mutation-specific defects in CHIP activity, including increased formation of soluble oligomers, decreased interactions with chaperones, diminished substrate ubiquitination, and reduced steady-state levels in cells.

nodes.description: Variants in the tetratricopeptide-repeat domain weaken the interaction between CHIP and its HSP70/HSC70 co-chaperones, so misfolded clients are not efficiently handed off to the ligase. This arm is separable from the catalytic arm: TPR variants can retain self-ubiquitination while failing to ubiquitinate HSC70, and the U-box p.Thr246Met variant conversely retains chaperone binding with no ligase activity.

nodes.description: The U-box-dependent E3 ubiquitin ligase activity of CHIP is abolished or reduced, so client proteins delivered by HSP70/HSC70 are no longer ubiquitinated. In the index p.Thr246Met allele the activity loss is complete while chaperone interactions are retained, so the catalytic defect can occur with chaperone binding intact. That allele is not a clean isolation of the catalytic arm, however: it also destabilizes and oligomerizes the protein, and its authors are explicit that it is not equivalent to total loss of CHIP.

Trehalose, an autophagy enhancer, raises CHIP and Hsp70 protein levels and reduces oxidative stress in SCAR16 patient fibroblasts. This is a cell-culture result in patient-derived fibroblasts only, proposed as a candidate rather than established therapy; there is no animal efficacy study and no clinical trial in SCAR16. It is recorded here because it is the one mechanism-directed therapeutic lead in the SCAR16 literature, not because it is available treatment.
